notes.title: Paranormal HK will be released on January 6th, 2020
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, thank you for your support and patience. We're thrilling to annouce Paranormal HK will  be released on January 6th, 2020.

Paranormal HK is a first person horror  game based on Chinese folklores and urban legends. While exploring in the ruins of the Kowloon Walled City, you may reveal the truths behind various paranormal events.

We hope to bring you a unique gaming experience , which is  different from other horror games. Meanwhile, please enjoy the charisma of Chinese cultures and stories.

See you next week.
